Slop Docs · In development

Document editor

Word and Google Docs, rebuilt for the browser.

Open now

Slop Docs has these main features: Real pages, styles and lists; Opens & saves DOCX and Markdown. It opens Word (.docx), Markdown, Plain text, HTML.

In development: some features listed below may not be finished yet.

What you can do with Slop Docs

  • A free word processor in your browser
  • Convert Markdown to Word (.docx)
  • A free Microsoft Word alternative in your browser
